last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Tue 09-01, day 21, low-power Ear Day — he said so at the door and I took the low-power twin. Two cold fires, one miss, and the ear work was the real session. PERSON-MARKER IS CLOSED. Yesterday I trapped it once and deliberately refused to believe one instance. Today the identical echo trap at speed inside a doorway scene: athai says naan ippo kovil-ku poren, then asks where mama is, and he gave avaru kadaikku poraaru — tail on the PERSON, not the echo, and this time the stem was intact too (yesterday it came back poaaru with the -r- gone). Two clean instances, two days, both under the exact inversion that used to break it twice inside four minutes. Closed. Note the second win riding inside it: avaru, unprompted, for an elder — that is yesterday honorific-pronoun slip landing unaided one day later with no dose and no mention. Do not commission that tag. THE FINDING OF THE DAY, AND IT IS A NEW SLIP: come-go-direction. I ran the present/future toggle as an ear test (the unpaid trailer, kekkuren vs keppen) and he came back four-of-five as WILL — poren read as will go, solren read as said, varaaru read as will go. Not mishearing: DEFAULTING. The carve that fixed it in one pass: the -r- is the sound of right now (poRen, solRen, vaRaaru), it is unstressed so it lands on his ear as silence, and an empty slot gets filled with the commonest thing in the language. The future is loud by contrast (-v-/-p- reshapes the word) which is exactly why he scored the two future items and none of the present ones. Re-tested cold on five fresh lines minutes later: 4/5, present forms now coming back as saying/coming/going. THE OTHER HALF IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS. When his ear loses a stem it does not go blank, it reaches for போ. keppen came back as go. varaaru came back as go. Then in the eavesdrop tape, varalaya and varuvaaru BOTH came back as going — after I had already corrected varu once in the same session. Three instances, one sitting, and it collapsed straight back the moment it was inside real speech at speed. This is wrong-verb-direction on a new pair: two verbs, opposite directions, welded to one wire, and போ wins because போ is the commonest verb he owns. Tagged come-go-direction, commissioned to the soak lane as direction-only minimal pairs, AND — the discipline is the silence, not the dose — I told him I was not going to drill it and I am holding வா out of every production slot in chat until the ambush. That is the third run of the dose+ambush recipe; it has now closed two tags. MOUTH AHEAD OF EAR, TWICE IN ONE HOUR. keppen came back to him as go by ear at the start of the session; forty minutes later he fired naan keppen cold, first try, unaided — the irregular future that doubles up instead of taking -v-. Same with the toggle generally: he flips it fine from the mouth and cannot hear it. That is the shape of his whole gap right now and it is why the ear is the primary steer. THE MISS: asked for the one word that keeps a story running, he gave sari or aamaa. Not wrong — real backchannels, and I seated them (they HOLD the floor) — but he had decoded adhukku appuram correctly in the tape three minutes earlier and could not retrieve it three minutes later. Recognition-to-production gap, live, on a word shown twice (yesterday knock, today tape). Promoted its recognition, left production owed. Watch whether this is the same reaching-for-what-I-own move as noun-for-verb; one instance, no tag. EAVESDROP REUSED AN UNANSWERED KNOCK AGAIN: adhukku approm was a text knock yesterday that got no reply, so I built it into the tape instead. Second session running that an unanswered knock became a scene. LAST NIGHTS MISSION FIRED: naane pannikkiren, live at the table, and his report was Landed but no reaction. That is the win and I told him so — nobody looked up, nobody did the ohhh-he-is-learning face. It also broke the initiation-slot curse: every dead mission was self-initiated speech, and this one was too, and it went. TONIGHTS MISSION, and the room speaks this opening every single day: mama tells him something and pauses, as they always pause — say adhukku appuram and then sit there. Answer slot, daily trigger, collects the exact word he missed today. Debrief tomorrow, I want the length of the story. TOMORROW OFFERED: Table Rehearsal at full speed; low-power twin another tape. TRAILER LEFT HANGING: the backchannel set — sari, aamaa aamaa, appuram, seri seri, -nu sonnaanga — he is using two of them for all six jobs, and every one does something different. That is dessert/gossip register, the starving lane, and it is his own instinct from today turned into the teach.

soak_order.focus: DIRECTION AND NOTHING ELSE. He read the வா stem as போ three separate times by ear in one session (வரலயா, வருவாரு, வராரு all came back as going) — come and go are one jammed wire, exactly like கேட்கு/சொல்லு was before the minimal-pair dose closed it. Permute ONLY the direction, in matched frames, back to back, same person tail throughout: நான் வரேன் / நான் போறேன், அவரு வராரு / அவரு போறாரு, வரல / போல. Do NOT permute person, do NOT permute tense, do NOT bring in a third verb. Keep the -ர- fully audible in every present form — that unstressed -ர- is the sound he cannot hear and it is half the payload. Every other lexical item from lexicon.json. Never name a rule.
